purpose: technical single-world geometry only, never final sprites

settings.front: model y negative; rear y positive; x positive is model right
settings.identity_policy: Fixed feature locations in all eight views; never duplicate a front facade on a rear view. Labels are source camera names, not inferred runtime headings.
settings.brief: Ordinary modest redbrick family house, cream frames, charcoal pitched tile roof, one lower attached single garage on model right. Main front door at x=-1.8,y=-4. One brick chimney on rear-left main roof. No luxury entrance, no extra wings.

coordinate_system: metres; front y=-depth/2; right x=+width/2; z up; ONE model rotated0/90/180/270 about z
depth_handling: orthographic triangle rasterization, barycentric per-pixel depth, keep nearest; no average-depth painter guess
svg_form: self-contained exact technical z-buffer raster; editable full world mesh is stored separately
